newsitem.title: USA: Gallery of History sees $0.10/shr gain.
newsitem.headline: Gallery of History sees $0.10/shr gain.

text.p: Gallery of History Inc said on Monday it had sold $1.8 million in inventory and expects the transaction to result in a one-time gain of about $330,000, or $0.10 per share after tax considerations.
Gallery also said it had completed the repurchase of 2,659,720 shares, or 46.8 percent of its outstanding common stock, for about $2 million.
Gallery said it expects its book value to increase by more than 45 percent, to about $2.15 per share, as a result of the transactions.
It said it now has 3,257,934 shares outstanding.

Gallery President Todd Axelrod said, "The repurchase of this large block of stock represents merely the first step in management's stated mission to greatly enhance shareholders' value. Management believes that the true value of the company is substantially in excess of both its stock's current market price and new book value per share, and will aggressively seek out other means to continue to dramatically increase shareholder value in the future."
